description: Render a page in headless Chromium and observe whether each <video> actually advances (samples currentTime before/after a play attempt), classifying every clip into playing|paused|stalled|empty|error with a reason. Catches black/non-playing videos that static audits miss — the most common real-world defect on marketing sites with video backgrounds. Pass url to render + observe, or dom_snapshot to classify pre-collected observations without a browser.

dom_snapshot.description: Pre-collected video observations to classify without rendering (deterministic path)

autoplayBlocked.description: True if play() was rejected with NotAllowedError

currentTimeEnd.description: currentTime recorded after the observe window

currentTimeStart.description: currentTime recorded before the play attempt

hasSource.description: True if currentSrc is non-empty OR the element has a src attribute or <source> child

paused.description: True if the element is paused

selector.description: CSS selector identifying the video element

observeMs.description: Milliseconds to wait between currentTime samples after play() attempt. Default: 1000

url.description: URL to render and observe (http/https or file://). Requires headless chromium.

name: audit_video_playback
